description: This file is a shell script containing test cases for Git blob comparison functionality, including diff commands and checks for index, mode, and path variations.

methods.name: run_diff
methods.description: Runs git diff with the given arguments, outputs to 'diff' file.

methods.name: check_index
methods.description: Checks if the diff contains the expected index line for given objects.

methods.name: check_mode
methods.description: Checks if the diff shows expected mode changes.

methods.name: check_paths
methods.description: Checks if the diff contains expected path differences.
